newsitem.title: USA: Hilton Hotels Corp to post Q4 loss - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Hilton Hotels Corp to post Q4 loss - WSJ.

text.p: Despite Wall Street predictions of profits in the $0.30 range, Hilton Hotels Corp will post a fourth quarter loss due to charges of about $200 million, mostly related to the company's $2 billion acquisition of Bally Entertainment Corp, The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
The Journal said the company will report a fourth quarter loss of $0.35 to $0.40 a share, citing an interview with Hilton Chief Financial Officer Matthew Hart.

Hart told the Journal that Hilton's bad luck in its high-stakes baccarat business will also have an adverse impact on profit. It will be the fourth time in the past six quarters that the game held back Hilton's performance, the story said.
